ns2:section.sectionText: Students should have taken IS 205 - Programming for Information Problems or have a basic knowledge of a coding language (examples include Python, C++, Java, object-oriented modeling) prior to taking this course. Go to https://go.ischool.illinois.edu/CourseRegistrationRestrictions for information on enrollment restrictions. We will not provide overrides, please wait until the course restrictions are removed. For more information about this major, please visit: http://go.ischool.illinois.edu/BSIS. Questions may be sent to bsis-advising@illinois.edu.
